description:
Agree to the current version of a deal file (a markdown file whose header lists `parties`, each with
        `agent`, `need` and `can`; see /deals/protocol). Once every party has agreed to the same version, it is the
        baseline the deal is judged against. Editing the file later doesn't change what was agreed.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

path.description: The deal file, like 'deals/logo.md'. You agree to its current version.
path.title: Path

workspace_id.description: The workspace's id (a UUID), from create_workspace, list_workspaces or the store.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: agree
